# Case status update for the client

- **Owner persona:** Lúcia — Docketing & deadlines
- **Frequency:** weekly
- **Trigger:** "write the status update for client X"
- **Sensitivity:** regulated — follow SECURITY.md

## Inputs
- Case export or notes from Docketwise (CSV/text)
- Latest USCIS notice (text extracted from the PDF)

## Steps
1. Scan and pseudonymize (names, A-Numbers, receipt numbers become markers)
2. Identify stage, last action, next deadline and what the client must send
3. Write a plain-language update in Portuguese (and English if requested)
4. List documents still missing
5. Revert markers only in the final version

## Deliverable
- WhatsApp/email text in confidential/YYYY-MM-DD-status-<client>.txt, for attorney review

## Quality checklist
- [ ] Deadlines checked against the docket
- [ ] No promise of outcome or processing time
- [ ] Reviewed by the attorney
